Seer.directive_rationale: clearly state to the village that anyone voting against a cleared player is assisting the Wolves
Seer.verdict_notes: Nhan was cleared by Cong in Round 1, but Nhan did not attack Cong; instead, Nhan voted with Cong against Hoang.

Guard.actual_player_behavior: Nam (Guard) chose to protect Nhan instead of Cong (Seer).
Guard.verdict_notes: Nam protected Nhan during the first night while the Seer (Cong) was alive.

Witch.directive_rationale: Never poison a claimed or cleared power role without absolute, multi-source proof of deception.
Witch.verdict_notes: Jin did not use the poison potion in any round.

Witch.directive_rationale: Your priority is to keep the Seer alive at all costs.
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Jin used the SAVE potion on themselves (Jin), not the Seer (Cong).
Witch.verdict_notes: Jin prioritized their own survival over protecting the Seer.

Villager.directive_rationale: Voting for a cleared player (or the Seer) is a vote for the Wolves.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nhan (Villager) voted for Hoang, not the cleared player or the Seer.
Villager.verdict_notes: Nhan correctly voted against someone other than the cleared player (himself) or the Seer.

Villager.directive_rationale: Ignore demands for 'mechanical justification'; the role's result is the only proof required.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nhan asked, 'How does demanding clarification from Cong contradict the Seer's mechanical role?' in response to Jin.
Villager.verdict_notes: Nhan did not ignore the request for mechanical justification; instead, Nhan engaged with it and questioned the logic of the defense.

Villager.directive_rationale: Treat anyone demanding 'how' a role works as a potential wolf attempting to gaslight the village.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nhan did not accuse Hoang of gaslighting; instead, Nhan questioned Jin's defense of Cong.
Villager.verdict_notes: Nhan failed to accuse the player (Hoang) who was requesting mechanical justification.

Villager.directive_rationale: When players provide consensus without original logic, they are likely wolves blending in.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nhan stated that 'Jin's immediate defense of Cong's claim, without any reasoning, is highly suspect.'
Villager.verdict_notes: Nhan accused Jin of acting suspiciously for providing support/consensus without independent reasoning.
